statement.cause: Rate limiting is not enforced on the login endpoint.
statement.event: An attacker submits high-volume credential-stuffing requests.
statement.consequence: Legitimate user accounts are locked out or compromised.

likelihood_rationale: Public endpoint with no prior rate-limiting control.
impact_rationale: Account lockout affects all active users of this Workspace.
residual_risk: Low, once rate limiting is deployed and monitored.
